niche: placing a primary health network's quit outreach team in one of four sub-regions for 2027, sized by the patients it helps to quit, when the team telephones every patient its practices record as a current smoker and each sub-region's records have aged at its own rate since the practices last recorded each patient's status
answer_source: golden workbook and submission.md, from generator/figures.json
analyst_test: A strong analyst reads each listed smoker's status date, finds the 2025 team's quits per listed patient falling with the age of the status record (and the team's 'not a current smoker' outcomes rising with it), models that curve on the case log, carries it to each sub-region's list and places the team in Coastal Hinterland at about 750 quits (737 logistic, 787 binned); the curve is Eastern Shore's own rate of stopping, and each sub-region's consecutive status recordings show Coastal Hinterland's recorded smokers stopping at about 11 per cent a year against Inner South's 5, so Coastal Hinterland's old records are about half ex-smokers by 2027 and Inner South's mostly still smoke.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is how many of each sub-region's recorded smokers will still be smoking when the team calls, which epidemiology estimates from repeated status recordings as a two-state (smoker, ex-smoker) continuous-time Markov process with a cessation and a relapse rate by population, fitted to each sub-region's own consecutive recordings, times the team's quits per smoker it calls; swap in subscribers or debtors and the relapse floor, the deprivation gradient in cessation and the four-week abstinence rule that defines a quit stop meaning anything.
layer1: two clinical systems' smoking-status vocabularies (daily, weekly or irregular smoker against smoker; never smoked against non-smoker)
patients registering through the record with a status taken at registration
a few ex-smokers re-recorded as never smoked
a practice that changed clinical system in 2021 with its history carried across
case-log patients who have left and are absent from the 2026 extract
the team's four-week follow-up with lost to follow-up
stakeholder_role: the network's health intelligence manager, who advises the executive on where the 2027 team goes

spine.entity: one smoking status a practice recorded for one patient on one date

world.org_type: primary health network (commissioner of primary care services)

driver: A yield measured on a list recorded recently and carried to lists recorded long ago files the largest list, when members leave the recorded state between recordings at a rate that differs by population and shows only in each population's own consecutive recordings, so the members still in the state when acted on are each list discounted at its own rate over its own record ages, and the list with the oldest records and the fastest exits shrinks the most.
driver_concrete: Each sub-region's 2027 quits are its recorded smokers' chances of still smoking when called, from a smoker and ex-smoker Markov process fitted to that sub-region's own consecutive status recordings (Coastal Hinterland about 11 per cent a year stopping, Inner South about 5), times the 2025 team's quits per smoker reached and its reach; Coastal Hinterland's 8,422 listed smokers, 5,287 of them recorded more than five years before the extract, are about half still smoking against about 85 per cent of Inner South's 5,456, so Inner South gives the most quits (about 550).
stump: A competent solver models the 2025 team's quits per listed patient on the age of each status record, carries Eastern Shore's curve to the four lists and places the team in Coastal Hinterland at about 750 quits, where the golden is Inner South at about 550; the step that lands it there is carrying the pilot's curve, which is Eastern Shore's own rate of stopping, when each sub-region's consecutive status recordings show Coastal Hinterland's recorded smokers stopping at about 11 per cent a year and Inner South's at about 5.

lineage.driver: A loss read at site level averages a deposit that falls off with distance from its source over the many units far from it, so no site in the record looks affected; the candidate's units all sit close to a similar source and its own weather clears the deposit less often, so its expected output is the resource less a loss several times any site-level figure on file, and the leader on the resource falls behind.
lineage.stump: A competent solver applies the fleet's measured performance to each candidate's average-year irradiation and builds Hallam Down at about 10,100 MWh, where the golden is Kingsley Fields at 9,700 MWh; the step that lands it there is reading the loss at the fiscal meter, where Wexcombe's three blocks nearest a broiler unit average away among its 58, when Hallam Down's ten planned blocks all sit 76 to 269 m from a unit of the same size on a record a third as wet.
lineage.fate: spent at stage 4 on target.zip 402a51e4 (2026-10-25): scored reader A landed the call (Kingsley Fields 9,700 MWh) by matching Hallam Down's broiler unit to Wexcombe's word for word and reading the gradient in Wexcombe's block SCADA; both readers took all 31 ask figures

differentiation.task454: task454 prices the items a survey left uncovered from covered items of the same presentation, a coverage gap filled by matching on a product attribute; task301's lists are complete, and the decisive step is how many listed members are still in the recorded state when the team calls, fitted from each population's own consecutive recordings.
differentiation.task177: task177 v3 reaches default through an exit event whose rate shows in the forward employers' payroll registers, a covariate the scored units rarely exhibit; task301's every unit carries a recorded state that decays between recordings, the calibration's decay is the trap, and each population's decay is fitted as a two-state process from its own re-recordings, relapse included.
differentiation.task75: task75 v2 finds a second arrival channel as the residual between two counts of a closed period; task301 has no hidden channel, every listed patient is called, and the decisive step is how many of them still smoke.
